Name: Ser Boros Blount
Quirks: speaks with the bluster of a large man whose bluster is not always backed by courage
defers to whoever is immediately in front of him with more power
is aware of the gap between what the Kingsguard should be and what he is
CharacterDescription: Ser Boros Blount is a knight of the Kingsguard - a large man and capable fighter who has accumulated a reputation for being less than the Kingsguard is supposed to be. He is venal, cowardly when it is convenient, and more concerned with his own comfort than the oath he swore. He has beaten Sansa Stark on Joffrey's orders. He has stood aside when he should have acted. He is not evil exactly - he is weak, which in a position that requires strength is its own kind of failure. He is the kind of Kingsguard that makes the institution look like what Sandor Clegane says it is.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Ser Boros Blount is a knight from House Blount who serves in the Kingsguard of Robert I Baratheon. House Blount is from the Crownlands.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At King's Landing two days before Ned Stark's execution.
